integrity_notes: Analytical radial-polynomial proof; standalone finite checker passes 4,126 assertions but cannot prove the infinite quantifiers. Earlier sources supply transform and charge foundations; their known results are not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two positive-index Hermite input modes, first-Hermite analysis window, positive amplitude. The fold law and cubic resonances do not classify generic multi-mode signals, higher analysis windows, or spectrogram intensity extrema. Independent priority review is outstanding.
title: Five-circle bifurcation and conserved zero charge for two-mode first-Hermite spectrograms
